title: Mercury in Aries
caption: mercury in aries reads in straight lines. hints go right past it. say it plainly and it'll say it back

lines: Hints go *straight past* you.
Not because you don't care.
Mercury in Aries just reads in *straight lines.*
Aries is ruled by Mars,
so your words come out first and fast.
In love you need it said *plainly:*
I like you. I'm upset. I'm in.
Guessing games feel like *losing.*
Say it with me.
I deserve someone who *says it.*
My bluntness is a form of *trust.*
I can speak fast and still listen well.

title: Mercury in Taurus
caption: mercury in taurus hears the tone before the words. a calm voice settles it. a rushed one doesn't

lines: It's not *what* they said.
It's the *tone* they said it in.
Mercury in Taurus hears the voice first.
Taurus is said to rule the *throat,*
so a calm, low voice can settle you.
You think things through slowly and fully.
Rushing you for an answer feels like pressure.
Give you a day, and you'll give them the *truth.*
Say it with me.
I answer best when I'm not *rushed.*
Gentle words reach me faster.
What I say slowly, I *mean.*

title: Mercury in Gemini
caption: mercury in gemini has forty tabs open and wants to discuss all of them. a good reply is a love language

lines: You have *forty tabs* open in your head,
and you'd like to talk about *all* of them.
Mercury rules Gemini, so it's home here.
Two voices, one conversation.
In love you need *banter,*
a reply that keeps the thread going,
and someone fine with you changing the *subject*
three times in one sentence.
Say it with me.
My curiosity is how I *love.*
I want someone who never stops asking.
I want a mind that *plays* with mine.

title: Mercury in Cancer
caption: mercury in cancer still remembers the exact words from a fight four years ago. start the hard talks soft

lines: You still remember the exact *words*
from a fight four years ago.
Mercury in Cancer keeps what's said.
A few times a year, Mercury seems
to loop backwards across the sky.
You do the same with *conversations,*
circling back to check they were *kind.*
So you need hard talks to start *soft,*
with *we're okay* said first.
Say it with me.
My sensitivity is how I *listen.*
I deserve words that are *careful* with me.

title: Mercury in Leo
caption: mercury in leo tells every story like it ends in applause. praise it in public, give notes in private

lines: Every story you tell
is built for *applause.*
Mercury in Leo talks from the heart.
Leo is ruled by the Sun
and said to rule the *heart.*
So you need words that are *warm* and *generous.*
Praise in public. Notes in *private.*
Being ignored mid-sentence stings for days.
Say it with me.
I deserve to hear *you're amazing*
and I'm proud of you, often.
My big voice comes from a big *heart.*

title: Mercury in Virgo
caption: mercury in virgo says i love you as did you eat. it needs words that are specific, not someday

lines: Mercury is at its *sharpest* in Virgo.
It rules this sign and is exalted here.
So your I love you
sometimes sounds like, did you *eat?*
And you need words that are *specific.*
Not *we should* someday. A day. A time.
Vague feels like careless to you.
Follow-through is your favorite *sentence.*
Say it with me.
My attention to detail is *devotion.*
I deserve to be spoken to clearly.
I can take a compliment without *fixing* it.

title: Mercury in Libra
caption: mercury in libra rewrote one text eleven times so it would land softly. kind, but make it clear

lines: You've rewritten one text *eleven times*
so it would land *softly.*
That's Mercury in Libra.
Libra is ruled by Venus,
so even your words want to be *beautiful.*
You see both sides before you speak,
and you need the same courtesy back:
a calm voice, a fair hearing, no *ambush.*
Say it with me.
I can be *kind* and still be clear.
My opinion counts, even when it's mine alone.
I deserve a love that *speaks gently.*

title: Mercury in Scorpio
caption: mercury in scorpio hears what you don't say louder than what you do. it was never too intense

lines: What people *don't* say
is the loudest thing in the room to you.
Mercury in Scorpio reads between *every* line.
So small talk feels like a *locked door.*
You want the real conversation,
the one at three in the morning.
In love you need *honesty,* all of it.
Half-truths hurt you more than *hard* ones.
And here's the thing.
You were never *too intense.*
You just wanted someone to tell you the *truth.*

title: Mercury in Sagittarius
caption: mercury in sagittarius would rather talk about the meaning of life than what's for dinner. honestly, same

lines: You'd rather talk about the *meaning* of life
than what's for dinner.
Mercury in Sagittarius thinks in *big skies.*
Sagittarius belongs to the ninth house:
travel, belief, and the big questions.
So you need someone who'll *wonder* with you,
laugh at your bluntness,
and tell you the truth right back.
Say it with me.
My honesty comes from *hope,* not harm.
I can aim my words with *care.*
I want a love that *talks big* with me.

title: Mercury in Capricorn
caption: mercury in capricorn doesn't say much, but it has never said a word it didn't mean. dry humor included

lines: You don't say much.
But you've never said a word you didn't *mean.*
Mercury in Capricorn talks like it's in *writing.*
Capricorn belongs to the tenth house:
reputation, and what you build.
So you need words with *weight* behind them,
a plan, a promise, a follow-through.
Pretty words with no plan feel like *noise.*
Say it with me.
My dry humor is a *love language.*
I can say *I feel* before I'll fix it.
My word is worth *waiting* for.

title: Mercury in Aquarius
caption: mercury in aquarius fell for someone over an opinion nobody else in the room had. stay strange

lines: You fell for someone because of an *opinion*
nobody else in the room had.
Mercury in Aquarius loves an *original* mind.
You think a few years ahead,
so you need room to say the *strange* thing,
and to be talked to like a best friend:
honest, curious, and never *clingy.*
The right person won't *correct* your weirdness.
They'll ask you to say *more.*

title: Mercury in Pisces
caption: mercury in pisces has sent a song instead of saying how it feels. more than once. listen to the song

lines: Instead of saying how you feel,
you've sent someone a *song.*
Mercury in Pisces speaks in *feelings,* not facts.
Mercury is the planet of words,
and in Pisces, words go a little *misty.*
You know things before you can explain them.
So you need someone patient with your silences,
who hears the *song* and gets the message.
Say it with me.
I don't have to be *literal* to be understood.
My quiet is still *talking.*
I deserve someone fluent in *me.*
